sentence: This project uses computer simulations to study how symmetric molecules change structure during ultrafast processes driven by a laser or by particle collisions.
This project studies how marine bacteria and the viruses that infect them change nitrogen cycling in oxygen minimum zones.
This project studies how diatoms, a type of marine algae, give off fluorescence and harvest light when they are under stress.
This project builds a database and Bayesian networks that predict how humans and wildlife interact, focusing on birds around the world.
This project studies how indigenous ecological knowledge is passed on within a society and used to adapt to climate change.
This project studies how renewable biomass sticks to polymers and how this affects the making and performance of composite materials.
This project brings researchers together to share recent advances in optimization and control theory, including uses in deep learning and data science.
This project builds a form of force microscopy that maps where molecules absorb light and how their atomic bonds deform.
This project studies how the ocean and atmosphere drive extreme heat waves on the coast and how they affect human health.
This project maintains and improves a research network that carries astronomy data across the Americas and Africa.
This project studies volatile organic compounds made by microbes in aged concrete to detect when the concrete is deteriorating.
This project builds a deep learning model that predicts when jumping genes add new material to genes, and compares humans and primates.
This project builds sensors from microscopic diamond particles to measure magnetic fields, charge and temperature in low-temperature plasmas.
This project studies how the structure of models and data affects how machine learning algorithms train and how well they generalize.
This project does research on cybersecurity, including cryptography, big data, smart grids and the use of artificial intelligence for security.
